name: TC-EV-02: Call Now assistance lead submits successfully on Electric Commercial Vehicles
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/CategoryPages/ElectricVehicle.cy.js#CategoryPages - ElectricVehicle [en] — Electric Commercial Vehicles TC-EV-02: Call Now assistance lead submits successfully on Electric Commercial Vehicles
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-EV-02
**Title:** Call Now assistance lead submits successfully on Electric Commercial Vehicles
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Electric Commercial Vehicles page, click the "Still confused?" widget's Call Now button to open the assistance lead form (a different component from Check Truck Price — placeholder-only inputs, heading "SHARE YOUR DETAILS TO GET ASSISTANCE"), fill model, name, mobile and city, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
The assistance form closes after a successful submission.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Electric Commercial Vehicles page
2. Click Call Now to open the assistance lead form
3. Fill model, name, mobile and city
4. Submit and verify the assistance form closes
